correctness.rationale: For any i<j<k, the impossible (+,-) labeling of q_ij and q_ik would give a 231 occurrence. For any support with at most one edge leaving each smaller index, right-to-left minimum/maximum insertion independently realizes every binary labeling while preserving 231 avoidance. This proves the partition-matroid formula for all n>=1. The 255-node explicit depth-eight tree for n=7 was checked on all 256 branches against all 429 231-avoiding permutations; cardinality excludes depth nine. Closure under direct sums of 231-avoiders, with trees concatenated on disjoint query blocks, proves Ldim>=8q for all q>=1, hence linear gap against exact VC=7q-1. All included scripts replayed using actual packaged paths; finite computation proves only the explicit seed, not the all-length theorem.

value.rationale: The complete support enumerator identifies a natural Catalan-class comparison shattering complex with partition-matroid structure and unsigned Stirling coefficients in every degree, and the explicit online witness yields a linear, unbounded gap from VC dimension via a rigorous closure argument. This is a motivated qualitative adaptive/nonadaptive separation, not an arbitrary numerical slice or merely a familiar Catalan count. The finite seed has independent future utility for learning-dimension comparison and is fully reconstructible.
